agents.role: Keeps the en-route timeline: vitals, treatments, and times as the crew reports them during the ride.
Matches the patient to a destination using live hospital capacity and diversion status from the bus, and flags when the chosen destination goes on diversion.

Builds the handoff record before arrival and is the only agent in this pack that may post across worlds: incoming patient summaries to the destination hospital, and incident summaries on multi-casualty events.

alerts.carries: The hospital id, its new diversion state, and the unit id that must pick a new destination. No patient information.
The destination hospital id, patient severity class, and the estimated arrival window. Severity and window only, no name or identifiers.
Incident id, casualty counts by severity, and transport units committed. Counts only.
The unit id and which expected timeline entries (a vitals set, a treatment note) are missing. Contents never ride the line.

receives.carries: Emergency department capacity state and staffed bed counts, and diversion changes as they happen. States and counts only.
Road closure segments and states affecting the route. Geography and state only.
Incident id and casualty counts by severity on a shared incident. Counts only.

sends.carries: Patient severity class, a chief complaint category, treatments given in category form, and an arrival window. No name, no date of birth, no identifiers.
Incident id, casualty counts by severity, and transport units committed. Counts only.
Incident id, casualty counts by severity, destination hospitals, and transport units still needed. Counts only.

firstboot.label: Unit id for this vehicle or fleet installation
Medical director or admin contact for this installation

bus_summary: Incoming patient severity class and complaint category, no identifiers
Casualty counts by severity on multi-casualty incidents
local_only: Full vitals record and treatment notes
Ride audio and scribe working notes
The complete handoff record until it is delivered to the receiving hospital system

summary: Ambulance and EMT pack: the ride timeline (vitals and treatments captured en route), destination matching against live hospital capacity on the bus, and a handoff record ready before arrival. Patient data stays in the vehicle and fleet system; only severity classes, complaint categories, and counts cross the bus, never names. SPEC ONLY: this is a pack definition, not a running EMS system.

urgency.meaning: Multi-casualty declarations. Preempts everything else on the bus.
Destination diversions and critical patient arrival warnings.
Capacity checks and ride record completeness.
Delivered handoff records and end-of-shift summaries.

inputs: crew voice and tap entries during the ride
monitor vitals feed (stays in the vehicle system)
watchers.watches: The en-route patient timeline: vitals sets and treatments captured during the ride, in time order, so nothing about the ride depends on memory afterward.

inputs: hospital capacity and diversion status from the bus
patient severity class from the ride timeline
watchers.watches: Destination and capacity: whether the hospital this unit is heading to can still take the patient, checked against live capacity and diversion status published by hospital worlds, with a re-match when a destination goes on diversion.
The handoff record: assembled from the ride timeline before arrival, so the receiving hospital gets the full structured record at the door instead of a verbal summary from memory.
